    SELECT visit_occurrence_id, person_id, visit_start_date, visit_end_date

    WHERE visit_concept_id IN (9201, 262, 8717)
),
mi_index_candidates AS (
    SELECT v.person_id, v.visit_occurrence_id, v.visit_start_date, v.visit_end_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.person_id ORDER BY v.visit_start_date, v.visit_occurrence_id) AS rn
    FROM inpatient_visits v
    JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
      ON co.person_id = v.person_id
     AND co.visit_occurrence_id = v.visit_occurrence_id
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca_mi
      ON ca_mi.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
     AND ca_mi.ancestor_concept_id = 312327
),
mi_index AS (
    SELECT person_id, visit_occurrence_id, visit_start_date, visit_end_date
    FROM mi_index_candidates
    WHERE rn = 1
),
reduced_ef AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.person_id, i.visit_occurrence_id
    FROM mi_index i
    JOIN omop.measurement m
      ON m.person_id = i.person_id
     AND m.measurement_concept_id IN (4323433,4108582,3027172,3019817,3004651,3016171,3004216,3007326,3005737,21494028)
     AND m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL
     AND m.value_as_number <= 40
     AND m.measurement_date BETWEEN DATEADD(day, -180, i.visit_start_date) AND DATEADD(day, 30, i.visit_end_date)
),
drug_class_exposure AS (
    SELECT i.person_id, i.visit_occurrence_id,
           MAX(CASE WHEN ca_drug.ancestor_concept_id IN (1307046,1338005,1314002,1314577) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_beta1_selective,
           MAX(CASE WHEN ca_drug.ancestor_concept_id IN (1346823,1353766,1313200,1386957,1370109,902427) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS less_selective
    FROM mi_index i
    JOIN omop.drug_exposure de
      ON de.person_id = i.person_id
     AND de.drug_exposure_start_date BETWEEN i.visit_start_date AND DATEADD(day, 7, i.visit_end_date)
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca_drug
      ON ca_drug.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
     AND ca_drug.ancestor_concept_id IN (1307046,1338005,1314002,1314577,1346823,1353766,1313200,1386957,1370109,902427)
    GROUP BY i.person_id, i.visit_occurrence_id
),
classified AS (
    SELECT i.person_id, i.visit_occurrence_id, i.visit_start_date, i.visit_end_date,
           CASE WHEN d.high_beta1_selective = 1 AND ISNULL(d.less_selective,0) = 0 THEN 'Highly beta-1 selective'
                WHEN d.less_selective = 1 AND ISNULL(d.high_beta1_selective,0) = 0 THEN 'Less selective'
                WHEN d.high_beta1_selective = 1 AND d.less_selective = 1 THEN 'Both classes'
                ELSE 'No listed beta-blocker' END AS beta_blocker_class
    FROM mi_index i
    JOIN reduced_ef ef ON ef.person_id = i.person_id AND ef.visit_occurrence_id = i.visit_occurrence_id
    LEFT JOIN drug_class_exposure d ON d.person_id = i.person_id AND d.visit_occurrence_id = i.visit_occurrence_id

    FROM classified c
    JOIN inpatient_visits v2

     AND v2.visit_start_date <= DATEADD(day, 90, c.visit_end_date)
)

       CAST(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS decimal(10,4)) AS readmission_proportion_90d
FROM classified c
LEFT JOIN readmit r ON r.person_id = c.person_id AND r.visit_occurrence_id = c.visit_occurrence_id
GROUP BY beta_blocker_class
ORDER BY beta_blocker_class

  SELECT person_id, visit_occurrence_id, visit_start_date, visit_end_date
  FROM (
    SELECT e.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY person_id ORDER BY visit_start_date, visit_occurrence_id) rn
    FROM eligible e
  ) x WHERE rn = 1
), ingredient_exposure AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.person_id, i.visit_occurrence_id,
    CASE ca.ancestor_concept_id
      WHEN 1307046 THEN 'metoprolol'
      WHEN 1338005 THEN 'bisoprolol'
      WHEN 1314002 THEN 'atenolol'
      WHEN 1314577 THEN 'nebivolol'
      WHEN 1346823 THEN 'carvedilol'
      WHEN 1353766 THEN 'propranolol'
      WHEN 1313200 THEN 'nadolol'
      WHEN 1386957 THEN 'labetalol'
      WHEN 1370109 THEN 'sotalol'
      WHEN 902427 THEN 'timolol'
    END AS ingredient
  FROM idx i
  JOIN omop.drug_exposure de ON de.person_id = i.person_id
    AND de.drug_exposure_start_date BETWEEN i.visit_start_date AND DATEADD(day,7,i.visit_end_date)
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
    AND ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (1307046,1338005,1314002,1314577,1346823,1353766,1313200,1386957,1370109,902427)
)
SELECT ingredient, COUNT(*) AS exposed_index_admissions
FROM ingredient_exposure
GROUP BY ingredient
ORDER BY exposed_index_admissions DESC

So, the **less selective beta-blocker class** showed the lower 90-day all-cause readmission proportion: **45.9% vs 48.8%**.

Cohort definition used: inpatient MI visit, reduced EF defined as LVEF ≤40% within −180 to +30 days of the MI admission, beta-blocker exposure from admission through 7 days after discharge, and subsequent inpatient visit within 90 days after discharge.

A plausible mechanistic explanation is that less selective agents—especially **carvedilol**, the dominant drug in that class here—block **β1 plus β2 and α1 adrenergic signaling**. In post-MI HFrEF, this may reduce maladaptive catecholamine signaling more broadly than β1-selective blockade alone: lowering heart rate/renin release via β1 blockade, reducing peripheral afterload via α1 blockade, and potentially modulating β2-associated myocardial stress/remodeling pathways. This could support fewer early decompensations/readmissions, though the observed difference is unadjusted and may reflect confounding by indication or prescribing patterns.
